repo_info.commit_message:
The terminal app (#38)

* TF19 Session A: the terminal app's tests, frozen

Spec section 17.2 (how the app opens, the screens, the facts rule,
saves, charts as links, keys and exits, what it never does, Prove's
app shell), section 17.3 for the pages it links to, the design's
DM5, DM6, DM9, DM12 and DM13, and the objects PA11 sent here.

- tf19_support.py: the readings A1 to A15; the app driven by Textual's
  pilot and read cell by cell, the core spied on, the browser,
  clipboard, network and environment faked; the bare command on a
  pseudo-terminal; the pins' corpus.
- test_tf19_open, screens, facts, saves, links, keys, never, shell,
  objects, unchanged (TF19-1 to TF19-12) and the freeze guard
  (TF19-13).
- fixtures/tf19: main b988bd3's pins and their maker; the Prove shell
  commit (main d04e378) and the definitions copied from it.

Readings and yes/nos: log/trace-tf19-a/rulings.md (TF19-A1 to A23,
N1 to N3).

* TF19-FT1: the dependency list gains textual>=6.4.0

Section 17.2 (AD5) makes Textual a core dependency of the terminal app,
at the floor Prove declares. tests/ingest/test_import_cli.py's S22 pins
the list; its guard line in tests/fixtures/tf9/frozen-tests.sha256
moves with it. Owed as TF19-FT1.

* TF19-FT2: TF18-21's top help test takes TF19's two options out first

Section 17.2 makes --store PATH and --config PATH options of the bare
command; TF19-11 holds how they are added. TF18-21 now removes their
usage tokens and option rows before its own checks; TF18-24's guard
line moves with it. Owed as TF19-FT2.

* TF19-FT3: TF9-5b lets the terminal app's modules import Rich

Textual draws through Rich, and Prove's app shell, which Trace's app
copies (section 17.2, AD5), imports Rich's Text. _pretty.py stays the
one module outside poisson_trace/_app*.py that imports Rich. The file
has no guard line. Owed as TF19-FT3.

* TF19: the dependency list gains textual>=6.4.0, the floor Prove declares (FT1)

* TF19: the objects only the app needs, as core functions (PA11, TF19-A7 to A9)

core.saved_verdicts, core.run_sources and core.found_results, each a frozen
dataclass list, pure: the saved verdicts newest first, each run's target or the
tool and files an import came from, and the result files init finds with the
import line init prints for each, every file its own line (setup.file_lines
gains limit=), and whether a run under the folder was imported from a file with
the same bytes (ingest.writer.read_produced_by, beside the record's writer).

* TF19: the bare command opens the terminal app (section 17.2, AD4; A2 to A4)

--store PATH and --config PATH join the bare command's options, their help on
the line under them with the help column held (TF19-A3); with no verb on a
terminal (stdin and stdout terminals, CI unset, TERM not dumb, no --plain:
look.opens_app, Session.plain) the app opens on the config or the store;
anywhere else the no-verb refusal stands as before (TF19-A4). commands.app
builds it, importing Textual there alone, a Textual that cannot be imported
being one refusal; commands.run_app runs it with a piped stderr taking
stdout's terminal; what it leaves to say once it has left is printed as a verb
prints it.

* TF19: Trace's copy of Prove's app shell from main d04e378 (AD5, TF19-A18)

The 25 definitions tests/fixtures/tf19/prove-shell.json names, copied from the
installed Prove by their source segments, poisson-prove read as poisson-trace,
ProveApp's drawing and moves as methods of a class Shell; Prove's private
modules are not imported.

* TF19: the terminal app's screens on the shell (section 17.2; DM5, DM6, DM9, DM12, DM13)

TraceApp and every screen: home, runs, run, imports and its question, the two
pickers, the four verdict screens laid out from the result's own report, changes,
could not say, help. Each screen renders what the core returns and computes
nothing; a verdict shown is saved and the pages rebuilt before a link shows;
a name and an import happen after a [y/N] answered y; work runs beside the
screen and Ctrl-C exits at once, saying what was kept; the lines behind m, k
and t scroll; one meaning per letter; only NO_COLOR is read.
